name: web-ui-tester
description: Let Claude drive and inspect real web pages in long-lived Chromium sessions: accessibility-tree snapshots with clickable refs, console and network diagnostics, and a built-in agent that runs a task and reports what broke.

google_api_key.title: Google Gemini API key (optional)
google_api_key.description: Only used by run_task, the built-in agent, with a Gemini model (the default). Every other tool works without a key.

anthropic_api_key.title: Anthropic API key (optional)
anthropic_api_key.description: Only used by run_task with an Anthropic model. Set the agent model to "anthropic" to use it.

agent_model.title: Agent model
agent_model.description: Model for run_task, as provider or provider:modelId, e.g. google:gemini-flash-latest or anthropic.

headless.title: Headless browser
headless.description: Run Chromium without a window. Turn off to watch the browser.

cdp_url.title: Attach to Chrome over CDP (optional)
cdp_url.description: DevTools endpoint of a Chrome you started with --remote-debugging-port, e.g. http://127.0.0.1:9222. Sessions then drive that browser instead of launching one.

cdp_port.title: Expose the browser over CDP (optional)
cdp_port.description: Local port on which the launched browser accepts DevTools-protocol clients, such as chrome-devtools-mcp, e.g. 9222. Leave empty to keep it private.
